summary: DATE-verification bug fix (iter_15) verified end-to-end. Created /app/backend/tests/test_daily_summary_date_verification.py with 12 targeted tests (prompt-content, mocked _generate_summary flow, temperature grep, cache-slot stale doc, and LIVE Gemini calls). ALL 12 PASSED in 56.1s. Bug fix CONFIRMED WORKING: the raw LIVE summary generated on 2026-07-13 for force_refresh=true contains ZERO references to Mad Cool Festival (which ended 2026-07-12), ZERO references to Auditorio Miguel Ríos de Rivas, and every [GRANDES EVENTOS] and [TEATROS Y OCIO] bullet includes an explicit date or date range that covers today (e.g. 'Veranos de la Villa 2026 del 7 de julio al 29 de agosto', 'Fescinal 16+ hoy 2026-07-13', 'Chulíssima hoy 2026-07-13', 'Drawing Possibilities del 17 abril al 14 julio'). Prompt unit-checks: all 14 required keywords present (REGLA #0, VERIFICACIÓN DE FECHA, Paso 1..4, FECHA INICIO, FECHA FIN, Mad Cool, Auditorio, DESCARTA, PROHIBIDO, AYER, MAÑANA); today's ISO date appears 6 times in the prompt (>=2). Mock-based flow check: _generate_summary calls _generate_summary_sync exactly once, then _verify_events_sync exactly once with the initial summary text, and the final payload uses the verified/modified content (Mad Cool bullet removed). Temperature: main gen=0.2, verify pass=0.1 confirmed via source grep. Cache: stale doc with cache_slot='STALE-SLOT' is NOT returned by _load_cached(). LIVE: second (non-force) call returns identical generated_at (cache hit). Public /daily-summary-public returns 200 with success/summary/day_name/date. Gemini quota is healthy — force_refresh actually regenerated in ~30s including the second verify pass.
raw_live_summary_generated_at_2026-07-13: [METEO HOY] 21-32°C, sin lluvia. [GRANDES EVENTOS] Babasónicos en Real Jardín Botánico 19:30 (hoy 2026-07-13), Veranos de la Villa (del 7-jul al 29-ago), Fescinal 16+ en Parque Bombilla (hoy 22:15-1:00, último día), Cine de Verano Matadero (del 2 al 31 julio). [TEATROS Y OCIO] Exposición Thyssen 'Esperanza a la fuerza' (1-15 julio), 'Yo fui a EGB' CondeDuque (8 julio-30 ago), Drawing Possibilities 1 Mira Madrid (17 abr-14 jul), Chulíssima Espacio Gran Vía (hoy 21:00), Emociones Teatro Flamenco (diario), Museo Luz Madrid (hoy 14:40). [ALERTAS DE TRÁFICO] Restricciones camiones A-1/A-2/A-3/A-5 21:00-23:00, campaña DGT alcohol/drogas. [AEROPUERTO] injected. [PREVISIÓN MAÑANA] 20-35°C, MAD RAVE en NEXT Clubbing 23:59-05:30 (martes). NO MAD COOL, NO AUDITORIO RIVAS, no past-weekend references. Bug fix verified.

critical_code_review_comments: routers/daily_summary.py:311-440 — _build_prompt() now emits a REGLA #0 block with a 4-step FECHA_INICIO/FECHA_FIN verification checklist and explicit Mad Cool + Auditorio Rivas anti-examples. All 14 keywords required by the reviewer are present. Today's ISO date embedded 6 times (spec required >=2). Clean.

routers/daily_summary.py:603-666 — NEW _verify_events_sync is a defensive second Gemini pass with Google Search grounding. Safety guards are solid: (a) returns original text if GEMINI_API_KEY missing, (b) returns original if Gemini call raises, (c) returns original if response is empty OR missing [GRANDES EVENTOS] header, (d) returns original if any mandatory section was dropped by the verify pass. Temperature=0.1 for maximum determinism.

routers/daily_summary.py:669-694 — _generate_summary now awaits _verify_events_sync after the primary generation, wrapped in try/except so the primary text is preserved on any failure. Airport section is injected AFTER the verify pass, which is the correct order because the verify pass ignores [AEROPUERTO] anyway.
routers/daily_summary.py:529 — Temperature lowered from 0.4 → 0.2 for the main generation. Confirmed via source grep. Sensible choice for a date-verification prompt.

Note: the verify pass makes a second Gemini call for every regeneration (~15-25s extra). Cache slot is 4 hours, so worst case = 6 double-passes per day per instance = acceptable quota footprint. If the user reports quota pressure, we could gate the verify pass behind 'if any bullet lacks a date-range parenthetical'.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter_15 (date-verification via REGLA #0 + second Gemini verify pass) is fully covered by /app/backend/tests/test_daily_summary_date_verification.py. That file is now the primary regression for the daily-summary router. The older iter_14 file /app/backend/tests/test_daily_summary_freshness.py has 5 outdated literal-string tests that must be updated OR removed. On the live Gemini side: quota is HEALTHY as of 2026-07-13 12:18 Madrid — force_refresh completed in ~30s. If a future run hits 503, the tests gracefully pytest.skip. Manual eyeball of the raw summary printed by teardown_module confirmed zero Mad Cool / Auditorio Rivas / past-weekend leakage.
rca_of_the_issue: Original iter_14 fix addressed HOUR-based staleness (concerts that ended earlier today) but multi-day-festival DATE staleness was still leaking through because Google Search Grounding returns 'Mad Cool 2026' as a HIGHLIGHTED event even after the festival ended — the model conflates 'the event exists in 2026' with 'the event is happening right now'. Fix (iter_15) applied by main agent in three layers: (1) prompt REGLA #0 now requires a 4-step FECHA_INICIO/FECHA_FIN checklist per event with explicit Mad Cool + Auditorio Rivas anti-examples so the model has concrete negative training in-context; (2) a second Gemini pass (_verify_events_sync) re-visits every bullet with fresh Google Search and prunes those whose date range doesn't cover today (temperature 0.1 for determinism, safe-fallback to original text on any error); (3) temperature lowered 0.4→0.2 on the main call for less creative date-guessing. Verification of the fix (this run): the raw summary produced on 2026-07-13 12:18 Madrid contains ZERO of the previously-leaking events (Mad Cool, Auditorio Rivas) and every event bullet in GRANDES EVENTOS and TEATROS Y OCIO carries an explicit today-covering date or date-range. Bug is resolved.
